milestones.description: Uses inventory_has because crafting sticks from birch planks places them directly into the player's inventory. The player starts with 0 sticks (only 8 birch planks), so any stick in inventory confirms the crafting task was completed. The recipe (2 planks → 4 sticks) is achievable with the provided materials.

Uses inventory_has because crafting a birch sign places it directly into the player's inventory. The player starts with 0 birch signs, so any birch_sign in inventory confirms the crafting task was completed. The recipe (6 birch planks + 1 stick → 3 birch signs) requires sticks from milestone 1, naturally enforcing the dependency order.
